eq-ch10-posts-add: A post adds a producer's increment to the listed rows of a direction's stage total, in call order and never fused.
eq-ch10-prescribed-book: The prescribed-face apply books the face-area-weighted change it makes on the prescribed faces, per row.
eq-ch10-wallbatch-flush: The wall batch books each slot's face-area-weighted change, row by row, at the end of the stage.
eq-ch10-amounts-fold: The step amount folds each stage's booked rates with w2 dt and its posts with weight one, both scaled by the later stages' w1.
eq-ch10-amounts-recursion: The step field accumulates the stage totals with the integrator's weights, stage by stage.
eq-ch10-counts-sum: A count mask's contribution is the difference of the integer cumulative sum at its two ends.
eq-ch10-budget-close: The boundary transfer is the outward, area-weighted step field over the boundary faces; with no source it balances the change of the totals.
